g.text: Each row holds the stated controls fixed. The K row follows its selected test-space/quadrature policy.
Circles: source numerical checks passed. Crosses: failed/unverified. 2D: six development cases; 3D screening/mesh: four exposed cases; 3D time endpoints: full exposed validation.
Fused cost includes input/initial fit, evolution and output. Iteration counts are not seconds. Numbers use conditional reference estimates.
